notes.content:

notes.title: Add features-sort by author
notes.content:
Add-Sort pages by author
Add a new page
Sort by author
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38159096/64d8357ed5fb81dde101f2dfabedfb5bb43f9330.png[/img]

At first this page is empty
To right-click the author, select Sort by Author-Update
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38159096/015c91f241a6331f2cda97618bf737364a3be3ea.png[/img]

The author name is extracted based on the file name, the folder and compressed file name will be extracted, and the image file name will not be extracted.
Such as: (illustration) [Lu Xun] Moon under the thorns.zip
Will extract the content of [ ] "Lu Xun".

It is recommended to add authors that you frequently read or like to bookmarks,
Because the author name is automatically extracted, when there are many imported files, hundreds or thousands of authors will be extracted, which is very inconvenient to find.

notes.title: Instructions
notes.content:
[b]1. Zoom picture[/b]
While browsing pictures
Press and hold the right button of the mouse while scrolling the wheel
You can zoom the picture

[b]2. Slide up and down mode to set the width of the picture[/b]
Move the mouse to the bottom and there will be several buttons as shown below
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38159096/3626feaf28a6fdfd9f6828581ba6061f8a905bc8.png[/img]
Adaptive-the picture width is smaller than the window width, and the picture display width is not changed. The picture width is greater than the window width, the picture width is changed to the window width
100%-Regardless of the width of the image, it will be changed to the same width as the window
90%-No matter what the width of the image, it will change to 90% of the width of the window
80%, 70%, 60% Same as above

notes.title: No UI on opening the program, black screen
notes.content:
No UI on opening the program, black screen
This is a strange bug
Normally it should be like this
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38159096/85ec54b859a3e76fd6024c898fe2f0a5617d7613.png[/img]
Current solution
Open the settings and find the "Date and Time" tab
Add clocks in different time zones

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38159096/13af7e9e9aa2b38f25ae3aa856607c4cf021cca8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38159096/322bd2e78c7dedeba0859dcce247df96259cb1fa.png[/img]

The added time zone does not have to be the +9 Tokyo in the above picture
If one time zone fails, change to another time zone

Detailed reference
https://tieba.baidu.com/p/6316320226
17th and 18th floors

Scenario 2
win + R enter “regedit” to open the registry
Targeting
Computer\HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\TimeZoneInformation
“TimeZoneKeyName” within
Change the value of “TimeZoneKeyName” to “China Standard Time”

If it still doesn’t work, add my friend to contact me for a detailed chat
